theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_prod_of_rectangles
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ A B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → ν (V.starProjection ⁻¹' A ∩ Vᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = σ B * μHE[n] (A ∩ (V : Set (Euclid P)))) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]
